name: Meera Industries Limited
about: Meera Industries Limited manufactures and sells customized textile machinery and machinery parts in India and internationally. It provides two for one twisters, including spun yarn, double deck spun yarn, embroidery and industrial thread, and filament yarn twisters; servo controlled cop and cone assembly winders; ring twisters; lycra covering machines; TPRS twister machines; heavy duty twister and cabler machines; and continuous bulking and heat setting machines. The company also provides servicing of machineries. It also exports its products. Meera Industries Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Surat, India.
